entries.reason: Entry point of the macOS driver: the listen-only event tap, its run-loop thread and start-up handshake, the forwarding thread, the tap callback, and the modifier and input-mode handling that feeds the conversion-session state machine. Newly written; the key-code tables and the input-source selection live in the submodules.

Polling of the input source. The selection between the mode-key flag and the input-source query is excerpted; the polling loop and the query are newly written, because the query is submitted to the main dispatch queue without blocking, and the loop writes the flag only from a completed query.
Unit tests of the pure parts of the macOS driver, on cells and channels local to each test.
